articles.headline: US freezes green-card program for Microsoft, IT outsourcers and Adobe amid fraud crackdown
articles.summary: The US suspended key green-card access for major tech and IT employers while widening probes into universities. This could affect talent pipelines, hiring plans, and compliance strategy for companies that rely on imported technical labor or offshore IT services.

articles.headline: Samsung flags record profit on AI memory boom as chip shortage deepens
articles.summary: Samsung projected a massive quarterly profit jump, driven by strong demand for AI chips and memory. For businesses, this signals tighter supply and higher prices for DRAM, NAND, and HBM, which can raise costs for servers, cloud infrastructure, and AI deployments.

articles.headline: US software stocks hit fresh 2026 highs as AI-disruption fears ease
articles.summary: Software shares rose as analysts kept raising earnings expectations and argued that fears of immediate AI disruption were overstated. For business buyers, this suggests enterprise software vendors may retain pricing power while cybersecurity remains a priority spend area.
